timed_entries.frozen_v1: trusted raw v1 launch; grid B; four warps; prevalidated arguments
timed_entries.grouped: trusted raw grouped launch; grid ceil(B/4); BATCH and ROWS_PER_PROGRAM=4; four warps

excluded: allocation, public validation, first JIT/setup, warmup, checks, snapshots, telemetry
order: rotate six arm/policy measurements; reverse alternate six-sample blocks; each item occupies each position five times per process
address_policy: same shared buffers for all three implementations; repeated addresses, no cache flush
statistic: median of 30 interval averages per process; median of three process medians
correctness: actual C1024 input; each arm resets cache before initial call and before 100-call Graph replay; all backings checked
scope: two-case NVIDIA FP16 grouped microbenchmark; not all-six-case regression, model, DRAM, or AMD measurement
limits: Eager includes distinct host submission paths; Graph primary; no automatic speedup acceptance
observation: same policy as27; this run contains original/frozen_v1/grouped only; no cross-run speedup ratio
